title: Parker Paints: Every wall tells a story (60 s)

shots.line: In Zimbabwe, the sun doesn't just light up your walls. It bakes them.
Then the rains come. Season after season, colour fades, paint cracks, and walls begin to peel.
So we made paint for exactly these conditions.
Parker Paints glide on smooth and level out, with no brush marks and no roller tracks.
Weatherproof and UV resistant, so your colour keeps that just-painted depth for years.
From the living room to the roof, from wood to metal,
there's a Parker product for every surface. 29 of them, made right here in Zimbabwe.
shots.say: there's a Parker product for every surface. Twenty-nine of them, made right here in Zimbabwe.

shots.line: And our premium range is backed by a 10-year guarantee.
